WITH earned_premium AS (
  SELECT SUM(
    p.annual_premium * (
      LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01')
    ) / 365.0
  ) AS amount
  FROM policies p
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_001'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01'
), incurred_claims AS (
  SELECT SUM(c.claim_amount) AS amount
  FROM claims c
  JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_001'
    AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND c.status IN ('open', 'settled')
)
SELECT incurred_claims.amount / NULLIF(earned_premium.amount, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred_claims
CROSS JOIN earned_premium

    p.annual_premium * (

  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_002'
    AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01'

)
SELECT incurred.amount / NULLIF(earned.amount, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred CROSS JOIN earned

WITH earned_premium AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    p.annual_premium * GREATEST(
      0,
      LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01')
    ) / 365.0
  ), 0) AS amount
  FROM policies p
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_007'
), incurred_claims AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.claim_amount), 0) AS amount
  FROM claims c
  JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id
  JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id
  WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_007'
    AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
    AND c.status IN ('open', 'settled')
)
SELECT incurred_claims.amount / NULLIF(earned_premium.amount, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred_claims
CROSS JOIN earned_premium

WITH earned AS (SELECT SUM(p.annual_premium * (LEAST(p.end_date, DATE '2026-07-01') - GREATEST(p.start_date, DATE '2026-04-01')) / 365.0) AS amount FROM policies p JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_008' AND p.start_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND p.end_date > DATE '2026-04-01'), incurred AS (SELECT SUM(c.claim_amount) AS amount FROM claims c JOIN policies p ON p.id = c.policy_id JOIN products pr ON pr.id = p.product_id WHERE pr.product_code = 'product_008' AND c.claim_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND c.claim_date < DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.status IN ('open', 'settled')) SELECT incurred.amount / NULLIF(earned.amount, 0) AS loss_ratio FROM incurred CROSS JOIN earned
